Downtown East Social Ride

Baton Rouge, LA · Downtown East · Social

No-dropBeginner friendlyFamily

Downtown East Social Ride is a social group ride in Baton Rouge, LA. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Outside City Roots at Electric Depot. About 7–10 miles, pace of the slowest rider. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: pace of the slowest rider. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @downtowneastsocialride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Downtown East Social Ride group ride

A Monday evening ride through Downtown East that tells the neighborhood's history as it goes. Seven to 10 miles at the pace of the slowest rider. Free and open to everyone; lights are required by state law and the group hands out free ones.
